records.why: Journal items math_1_3-028 and -029 (teacher: "Go by the KICD rubric which has 4 criteria for this substrand and 4 levels ... Refer to KICD Core Maths Curriculum design" / "Can you present the information in tabular form just like in the KICD curriculum design?"). Not applied: four CBE levels cannot be held by the three-field partner contract (on hold pending the partner). Also, the KICD PDF (Grade10_Mathematics_Curriculum.pdf) has only a generic "Suggested Assessment Rubric: Numbers and Algebra" table, with indicators such as reciprocals and indices; I found no indicator rows specific to Sub-Strand 1.3 Quadratic Expressions and Equations. Needs the teacher to point to the page with the 4 quadratic-specific criteria. Recommended: when the contract allows four levels, build a 4-row-by-4-level table from those KICD indicators.
